8. Article 9 is amended as:
"Where the contractor has already transferred the right to land management to a third party by lease, equity contribution, or other means before the party that contracted out the land recovers the contracted land in accordance with Article 27 of the Rural Land Contracting Law, and the transfer period has not yet expired, a dispute arising from the collection of transfer consideration shall be handled separately according to the following circumstances:
(1) If the contractor has already collected the transfer consideration in a lump sum, and the party that contracted out the land requests the contractor to return the transfer consideration for the remaining transfer period, such request shall be upheld;
(2) If the transfer consideration is to be paid in installments, and the party that contracted out the land requests the third party to pay the transfer consideration in accordance with the provisions of the transfer contract, such request shall be upheld."
9. Article 10 is amended as:
"Where the contractor's return of the contracted land does not comply with the procedures provided in Article 30 of the Rural Land Contracting Law, such return shall not be determined as voluntary."
10. Article 11 is amended as:
"In the transfer of the right to land management, where a member of the said collective economic organization claims a priority right under the condition that the main terms such as transfer price and transfer period are the same, such claim shall be upheld, except in the following circumstances:
(1) the priority right claim was not raised within a reasonable period after written public notice;
(2) where there is no written public notice, the priority right claim was not raised within two months after a person outside the said collective economic organization began to use the contracted land."
11. Article 12 is amended as:
"Where the party that contracted out the land coerces the contractor into transferring the right to land management to a third party, and the contractor requests the revocation of the transfer contract concluded with the third party, such request shall be upheld.
Where the party that contracted out the land obstructs the contractor from lawfully transferring the right to land management, and the contractor requests removal of obstruction and compensation for losses, such request shall be upheld."
12. Article 13 is amended as:
"Where the contractor transfers his/her right to land contractual management without the consent of the party that contracted out the land, the transfer contract is void. However, this shall not apply if the party that contracted out the land has no legal reason to withhold consent or delays expressing its position."
13. Article 14 is amended as:
"Where the contractor lawfully transfers the right to land management by lease, equity contribution, or other means, and the party that contracted out the land requests confirmation of the invalidity of the contract solely on the ground that the contract for the transfer of the right to land management has not been filed for record, such request shall not be upheld."
14. Articles 15 and 21 are deleted.
15. Article 17 is amended as:
"Where the parties have not agreed on the period of transfer of leased land or the agreement is unclear, the matter shall be handled by reference to Article 730 of the Civil Code. Unless otherwise agreed by the parties or in the case of forest land contracting, the time for returning the contracted land shall be after the end of the crop harvest period or before the start of the next cultivation period.
If the other party requests the contractor to give appropriate compensation for inputs that have increased the land's productivity, such request shall be upheld."
16. Article 18 is amended as:
"Where the party that contracted out the land or other organization or individual, without authorization, intercepts or withholds the contracting income or the income from the transfer of the right to land management, and the contractor requests the return thereof, such request shall be upheld.
If the party that contracted out the land or other organization or individual claims set-off, such claim shall not be upheld."
17. Article 19 is amended as:
"Where a member of the said collective economic organization claims priority to contract under the condition that the main terms such as contract fee and contract period are the same, such claim shall be upheld. However, if the contract is awarded to an organization or individual outside the said collective economic organization after the democratic deliberation procedure provided by law has been passed and approved by the township (town) people's government, a claim of priority to contract made thereafter shall not be upheld."
18. Article 20 is amended as:
"Where the party that contracted out the land concludes two or more contracts of land contracting for the same piece of land, and all contractors claim to have obtained the right to land management, the matter shall be handled separately according to the following circumstances:
(1) the contractor that has registered according to law shall obtain the right to land management;
(2) if none has registered according to law, the contractor under the contract that took effect first shall obtain the right to land management;
(3) if it cannot be determined according to the preceding two items, the person who has lawfully occupied and used the contracted land according to the contract of land contracting shall obtain the right to land management, but the act and fact of one party forcibly occupying the contracted land first after the dispute arises shall not be used as the basis for determining the right to land management."
19. Article 22 is amended as:
"Where the contracted land is lawfully expropriated, and the contractor requests the party that contracted out the land to pay the compensation fees already received for above-ground fixtures and young crops, such request shall be upheld.
Where the contractor has already transferred the right to land management to a third party by lease, equity contribution, or other means, unless otherwise agreed by the parties, the compensation fees for young crops shall belong to the person who actually invested, and the compensation fees for above-ground fixtures shall belong to the owner of the fixtures."
20. Article 26 is amended as:
"When the People's Court hears a dispute case involving Article 5, Article 6, paragraph 1, item (2) and paragraph 2, and Article 15 of this Interpretation, mediation shall be emphasized. Where necessary, a people's mediation organization may be entrusted to conduct mediation."
21. The order of the articles is adjusted accordingly.

16. Revision of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Contracts for the Grant of State-owned Land Use Rights
1. The preamble is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly adjudicating disputes over contracts for the grant of state-owned land use rights, protecting the lawful rights and interests of the parties according to law, this Interpretation is formulated in accordance with the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Land Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, the Urban Real Estate Administration Law of the People's Republic of China and other legal provisions, and in light of civil trial practice."
2. Article 1 is revised as follows:
"For the purposes of this Interpretation, a contract for the grant of land use rights means a contract under which the competent department of natural resources of a city or county people's government, as the grantor, grants the use right of state-owned land to the grantee for a certain period of time, and the grantee pays the grant price for the land use right."
3. Article 2 is revised as follows:
"A contract for the grant of land use rights concluded between the administrative committee of a development zone, as the grantor, and the grantee shall be deemed void.
Where a contract for the grant of land use rights was concluded between the administrative committee of a development zone, as the grantor, and the grantee before the implementation of this Interpretation, and such contract has been ratified by the competent department of natural resources of the city or county people's government before the action is brought, the contract may be deemed valid."
4. Article 7 is revised as follows:
"For the purposes of this Interpretation, a contract for the transfer of land use rights means a contract under which the holder of land use rights, as the transferor, transfers the granted land use right to the transferee, and the transferee pays the consideration."
5. Articles 9, 11, and 16 are deleted.
6. Article 10 is revised as follows:
"Where the holder of land use rights, as the transferor, concludes several transfer contracts with respect to the same granted land use right, and all transferees request the performance of the contract where the transfer contracts are valid, the following shall apply respectively:
(1) Where a transferee has already undergone the formalities for registration of the change of land use rights, its request that the transferor perform contractual obligations such as delivery of the land shall be upheld;
(2) Where none of the transferees have undergone the formalities for registration of the change of land use rights, and a transferee has earlier legally taken possession of the land for investment and development, its request that the transferor perform contractual obligations such as registration of the change of land use rights shall be upheld;
(3) Where none of the transferees have undergone the formalities for registration of the change of land use rights, nor have they legally taken possession of the land for investment and development, and a transferee has earlier paid the land transfer price, its request that the transferor perform contractual obligations such as delivery of the land and registration of the change of land use rights shall be upheld;
(4) Where none of the contracts have been performed, the request of the transferee under the contract that was earlier established according to law to have the contract performed shall be upheld.
A transferee who fails to obtain the land use right and requests rescission of the contract and compensation for losses shall be dealt with according to the relevant provisions of the Civil Code."
7. Article 14 is revised as follows:
"For the purposes of this Interpretation, a contract for cooperative development of real estate means a contract under which the parties agree to provide granted land use rights, funds, etc. as joint investment, and to share profits and bear risks in cooperative real estate development as the essential content."
8. Article 17 is revised as follows:
"Where the amount of investment exceeds the amount agreed in the contract for cooperative development of real estate, and the parties fail to reach an agreement on the proportion of bearing the increased investment, it shall be determined according to the circumstances of the party in breach; where it cannot be determined due to reasons not attributable to the parties or the circumstances of the party in breach cannot be determined, it shall be determined according to the agreed investment proportion; where no investment proportion is agreed, it shall be determined according to the agreed profit distribution proportion."
9. Article 18 is revised as follows:
"Where the actual floor area of the building is less than that agreed in the contract for cooperative development of real estate, and the parties fail to reach an agreement on the distribution proportion of the actual floor area, it shall be determined according to the circumstances of the party in breach; where it cannot be determined due to reasons not attributable to the parties or the circumstances of the party in breach cannot be determined, it shall be determined according to the agreed profit distribution proportion."
10. The order of articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

17. Revision of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Mediation and Arbitration of Rural Land Contracting and Management Disputes
1. Article 7 is revised as follows:
"Property preservation measures taken in arbitration of rural land contracting and management disputes shall, after the party applying for preservation initiates litigation according to law, automatically be converted into property preservation measures in the litigation, and the provisions of Article 487 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China concerning the time limits for sealing up, distraining, and freezing shall apply."
2. Article 10 is revised as follows:
"Where a party applies to the people's court for enforcement of a mediation document or an award in accordance with Article 49 of the Law on Mediation and Arbitration of Rural Land Contracting and Management Disputes, and the conditions set forth in Article 16 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Enforcement Work of People's Courts (for Trial Implementation) are met, the people's court shall accept and enforce it."

18. Revision of the Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue concerning How to Apply Law in Cases of Disputes over Contracts for the Transfer of Land Use Rights of State-owned Land Reclaimed for Agricultural Use
The first paragraph of the main text is revised as follows:
"State-owned land that is reclaimed for agricultural use but not allocated to farmers' collectives for use does not fall within the scope of rural land as defined in Article 2 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Rural Land Contracting. The transfer of use rights of such land shall not be governed by the Law of the People's Republic of China on Rural Land Contracting, but shall be regulated by the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Land Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant legal provisions."

19. Revision of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Tourism Disputes
1. The preamble is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly adjudicating tourism disputes, protecting the lawful rights and interests of the parties according to law, these Provisions are formulated in accordance with the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests of the People's Republic of China, the Tourism Law of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant legal provisions, and in light of civil trial practice."
2. Article 3 is revised as follows:
"Where, due to the same cause attributable to the tourism operator, a tourist suffers personal injury or property loss, and the tourist chooses to request the tourism operator to bear liability for breach of contract or tort liability, the people's court shall conduct the trial based on the cause of action chosen by the party."
3. Article 6 is revised as follows:
"Where a tourism operator, by means of standard terms, notices, declarations, in-store announcements, etc., makes provisions that exclude or restrict the rights of tourists, mitigate or exempt the liability of the tourism operator, or increase the liability of tourists, which are unfair or unreasonable to tourists, and a tourist requests, in accordance with Article 26 of the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests, a determination that such content is invalid, the people's court shall uphold the request."
4. Article 9 is revised as follows:
"Where a tourism operator or a tourism auxiliary service provider processes a tourist's personal information by means of illegal collection, storage, use, processing, transmission, trading, provision, disclosure, etc., and the tourist requests that it bear corresponding liability, the people's court shall uphold the request."
5. Articles 13, 14, and 21 are deleted.
6. Article 16 is revised as follows:
"Where a tourism operator permits another person to operate tourism business under its name (affiliation), causing personal injury or property loss to a tourist, and the tourist requests, in accordance with Article 1,168 of the Civil Code, that the tourism operator and the affiliated person bear joint and several liability, the people's court shall uphold the request."
7. Article 17 is revised as follows:
"Where a tourism operator violates the contract by unilaterally changing the itinerary, omitting tourist attractions, reducing tourist service items, lowering the service standards, etc., and the tourist requests compensation for reasonable expenses such as uncompleted agreed tourist service items, the people's court shall uphold the request.
Where the tourism operator commits fraudulent acts when providing services, and the tourist requests, in accordance with the first paragraph of Article 55 of the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests, that the tourism operator bear punitive damages, the people's court shall uphold the request."
8. Article 22 is revised as follows:
"Where luggage or items kept by a tourism operator or a tourism auxiliary service provider on behalf of a tourist are damaged or lost, and the tourist requests compensation for losses, the people's court shall uphold the request, except in the following circumstances:
(1) The loss is caused by the tourist's failure to carry cash, negotiable securities, or valuables on their person, contrary to the prior statement or reminder of the tourism operator or tourism auxiliary service provider;
(2) The loss is caused by force majeure;
(3) The loss is caused by the tourist's fault;
(4) The loss is caused by the natural properties of the items."
9. Article 25 is revised as follows:
"During a tour where the tourism operator pre-designs and provides one or more services such as transportation, accommodation, and sightseeing at a fixed total price, without providing tour guide or escort services, and the tourist arranges the itinerary independently, if the services provided by the tourism operator do not conform to the contract and infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of the tourist, and the tourist requests that the tourism operator bear corresponding liability, the people's court shall uphold the request."
10. The order of articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

20. Revision of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Commercial Housing Sales Contracts
1. The preamble is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly and promptly adjudicating disputes over commercial housing sales contracts, this Interpretation is formulated in accordance with the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Urban Real Estate Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant laws, and in light of civil trial practice."
2. Article 3 is revised as follows:
"Sales advertisements and promotional materials for commercial housing shall constitute an invitation to offer. However, where the seller's statements and promises concerning the house and related facilities within the commercial housing development planning area are specific and definite, and have a material impact on the conclusion of the commercial housing sales contract and the determination of the housing price, they shall constitute an offer. Even if such statements and promises are not included in the commercial housing sales contract, they shall be deemed part of the contract, and if a party violates them, it shall bear liability for breach of contract."
3. Articles 7, 8, 9, and 14 are deleted.
4. Article 15 is revised as follows:
"Where, in accordance with Article 563 of the Civil Code, the seller delays delivery of the house or the buyer delays payment of the purchase price, and neither party performs within a reasonable period of three months after being urged, the party entitled to rescission may request rescission of the contract, which shall be upheld unless otherwise agreed by the parties.
Where the law does not provide otherwise or the parties have not agreed otherwise, the reasonable period for exercising the right of rescission after being urged by the other party shall be three months. Where the other party has not urged, the party entitled to rescission shall exercise the right within one year from the date on which it knew or should have known of the grounds for rescission. Failure to exercise it within such period shall cause the right of rescission to be extinguished."
5. Article 18 is revised as follows:
"Where, due to reasons attributable to the seller, the buyer fails to obtain the certificate of real property title beyond the following time limits, the seller shall bear liability for breach of contract, unless the parties have otherwise agreed:
(1) The time limit for registering the real estate as agreed in the commercial housing sales contract;
(2) Where the subject matter of the commercial housing sales contract is a house that has not yet been completed, 90 days from the date on which the house is delivered for use;
(3) Where the subject matter of the commercial housing sales contract is a completed house, 90 days from the date on which the contract is concluded.
If the contract does not stipulate liquidated damages or the amount of loss is difficult to determine, it may be calculated by reference to the standard for overdue loan interest charged by financial institutions as prescribed by the People's Bank of China, based on the total amount of the purchase price already paid."
6. Article 19 is revised as follows:
"Where, after the expiration of the time limit for registering the real estate as agreed in the commercial housing sales contract or as provided in Article 32 of the Regulations on the Administration of Development and Operation of Urban Real Estate, and for a period exceeding one year, due to reasons attributable to the seller, the buyer is unable to register the real estate, the buyer's request for rescission of the contract and compensation for losses shall be upheld."
7. Article 26 is revised as follows:
"Where the buyer fails to repay the loan as agreed in the commercial housing guaranteed loan contract and also fails to undergo the formalities for registration of real estate mortgage with the security holder, and the security holder brings an action against the buyer to request disposition of the buyer's contractual rights under the commercial housing sales contract, the seller shall be notified to participate in the proceedings; where the security holder also brings an action against the seller at the same time, if the seller provides a guarantee for the commercial housing guaranteed loan contract, the seller shall be listed as a co-defendant."
8. Article 27 is revised as follows:
"Where the buyer fails to repay the loan as agreed in the commercial housing guaranteed loan contract, but has already obtained the certificate of real property title and undergone the formalities for registration of real estate mortgage with the security holder, and the mortgagee requests the buyer to repay the loan or to be compensated preferentially from the mortgaged house, the seller shall not be added as a party unless the seller provides a guarantee."
9. The order of articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

21. Revision of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Urban House Lease Contracts
1. The preamble is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly adjudicating disputes over urban house lease contracts, protecting the lawful rights and interests of the parties according to law, this Interpretation is formulated in accordance with the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China and other legal provisions, and in light of civil trial practice."
2. Articles 4, 8, 15, 16, 17, 19, 21, 23, and 24 are deleted.
3. Article 5 is revised as follows:
"Where a house lease contract is void, and a party requests payment of a fee for use and occupation of the house by reference to the rent standard agreed in the contract, the people's court shall generally uphold the request.
Where a party requests compensation for losses suffered as a result of the voidness of the contract, the people's court shall handle it in accordance with Article 157 of the Civil Code and Articles 7, 11, and 12 of this Interpretation."
4. Article 6 is revised as follows:
"Where a lessor concludes several lease contracts with respect to the same house, and all lessees claim performance of the contracts where all contracts are valid, the people's court shall determine the lessee who shall perform the contract in the following order:
(1) One who has already legally taken possession of the leased house;
(2) One who has already undergone the formalities for registration and filing;
(3) One whose contract was established earlier.
Where a lessee who cannot obtain the leased house requests rescission of the contract and compensation for losses, the matter shall be dealt with according to the relevant provisions of the Civil Code."
5. Article 7 is revised as follows:
"Where the lessee, without authorization, alters the main structure and load-bearing structure of the house or extends it, and fails to restore it to its original condition within a reasonable period required by the lessor, and the lessor requests rescission of the contract and compensation for losses, the people's court shall handle it in accordance with Article 711 of the Civil Code."
6. Article 20 is revised as follows:
"Where the ownership of the leased house changes during the period of possession by the lessee in accordance with the lease contract, and the lessee requests the transferee of the house to continue performing the original lease contract, the people's court shall uphold the request, except in the following circumstances or where the parties have otherwise agreed:
(1) A mortgage was established on the house before it was leased, and the ownership changes due to the enforcement of the mortgage by the mortgagee;
(2) The house had been sealed up by a people's court according to law before it was leased."
7. The order of articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

22. Revision of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Determination of Liability for Compensation for Mental Harm in Civil Torts
1. The preamble is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly determining the liability for compensation for mental harm in the adjudication of civil tort cases, this Interpretation is formulated in accordance with the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China and other relevant legal provisions, and in light of adjudication practice."
2. Article 1 is revised as follows:
"Where personal rights and interests or specific objects of personal significance are infringed upon, and a natural person or his or her close relative brings an action before a people's court requesting compensation for mental harm, the people's court shall accept the case according to law."
3. Article 3 is revised as follows:
"Where the name, portrait, reputation, honor, privacy, remains, or ashes of a deceased person are infringed upon, and his or her close relative brings an action before a people's court requesting compensation for mental harm, the people's court shall uphold the request according to law."
4. Articles 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 11 are deleted.
5. Article 5 is revised as follows:
"Where a legal person or an unincorporated organization brings an action before a people's court requesting compensation for mental harm on the ground that its right to reputation, right to honor, or right to name has been infringed upon, the people's court shall not uphold the request."
6. Article 10 is revised as follows:
"The amount of compensation for mental harm shall be determined based on the following factors:
(1) The degree of fault of the tortfeasor, unless otherwise provided by law;
(2) The specific circumstances of the tort, such as the purpose, method, and occasion thereof;
(3) The consequences caused by the tort;
(4) The gains obtained by the tortfeasor;
(5) The economic capacity of the tortfeasor to assume liability;
(6) The average living standard of the locality where the court accepting the action is located."
7. The order of articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

23. Revision of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases of Personal Injury Compensation
1. The preamble is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly adjudicating cases of personal injury compensation, protecting the lawful rights and interests of the parties according to law, this Interpretation is formulated in accordance with the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant legal provisions, and in light of adjudication practice."
2. Article 1 is revised as follows:
"Where a person's life, body, or health is infringed, and the compensation-right holder initiates an action requesting the compensation-obligor to compensate for material damages and mental harm, the people's court shall accept the case.
The term 'compensation-right holder' as used in this Article refers to a victim who directly suffers personal injury due to a tort or other injurious cause, and the close relatives of a deceased victim.
The term 'compensation-obligor' as used in this Article refers to a natural person, legal person, or unincorporated organization that shall bear civil liability according to law due to its own or another person's tortious act or other injurious cause."
3. Articles 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 15, 16, 17, 18, and 31 are deleted.
4. Article 13 is revised as follows:
"Where a person providing gratuitous labor (helper) causes harm to another person while engaging in the helping activity, the person being helped (beneficiary) shall bear the compensation liability. After the beneficiary has borne the compensation liability, if it seeks recourse against the helper who acted intentionally or with gross negligence, the people's court shall uphold the request. If the beneficiary expressly refuses the help, it shall not bear the compensation liability."
5. Article 14 is revised as follows:
"Where a person providing gratuitous labor (helper) suffers personal injury due to the helping activity, the helper and the beneficiary shall bear liability in proportion to their respective fault; if the beneficiary expressly refuses the help, the beneficiary shall not bear the compensation liability, but may provide appropriate compensation within the scope of benefits received.
Where a helper suffers personal injury due to the act of a third party during the helping activity, the helper has the right to request the third party to bear the compensation liability, and also has the right to request the beneficiary to provide appropriate compensation. After the beneficiary has provided compensation, it may seek recourse against the third party."
6. A new article is added as Article 16:
"The living expenses of a person being supported shall be included in the disability compensation or death compensation."
7. Article 33 is revised as follows:
"Where a compensation-obligor requests payment of disability compensation and costs of assistive devices by way of periodic payments, it shall provide corresponding security. The people's court may, based on the compensation-obligor's payment ability and the provision of security, determine to pay the relevant expenses by way of periodic payments. However, expenses incurred before the conclusion of the first-instance court debate, the death compensation, and the solatium for mental harm shall be paid in a lump sum."
8. A new article is added as Article 23:
"The solatium for mental harm shall be determined by applying the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Determination of Liability for Compensation for Mental Harm in Civil Torts."
9. The order of articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

24. Revision of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Compensation for Damages in Road Traffic Accidents
1. The introductory part is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly adjudicating cases involving compensation for damages in road traffic accidents, this Interpretation is formulated in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Road Traffic Safety Law of the People's Republic of China, the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other laws, and in light of adjudication practice."
2. Article 1 is revised as follows:
"Where damage is caused by a motor vehicle in a traffic accident, if the owner or manager of the motor vehicle falls under any of the following circumstances, the People's Court shall find that such owner or manager is at fault for the occurrence of the damage, and shall apply Article 1209 of the Civil Code to determine their corresponding liability for compensation:
(1) knowing or ought to know that the motor vehicle has a defect, and such defect is one of the causes of the traffic accident;
(2) knowing or ought to know that the driver has no driving qualification or has not obtained the corresponding driving qualification;
(3) knowing or ought to know that the driver, due to alcohol consumption, use of psychotropic drugs or narcotic drugs under state control, or suffering from a disease that impairs safe driving of a motor vehicle, is legally incapable of driving a motor vehicle;
(4) other circumstances under which the owner or manager of the motor vehicle shall be found to be at fault."
3. Articles 2, 3, and 10 are deleted.
4. Article 4 is revised as follows:
"Where damage is caused by a motor vehicle that has been transferred multiple times but has not been registered, and the motor vehicle is liable for the damage, if a party requests that the assignee of the last transfer and delivery bear the compensation liability, the People's Court shall support such request."
5. Article 9 is revised as follows:
"Where damage is caused by a motor vehicle in a traffic accident due to defects in road management and maintenance, if a party requests the road manager to bear corresponding compensation liability, the People's Court shall support such request, unless the road manager can prove that it has fulfilled its management and maintenance obligations, including safety protection and warning, in accordance with laws, regulations, rules, or the requirements of national standards, industry standards, or local standards.
Where a vehicle or pedestrian that is legally prohibited from entering an expressway causes damage to itself in a traffic accident after entering the expressway, if a party requests the expressway manager to bear compensation liability, the provisions of Article 1243 of the Civil Code shall apply."
6. Article 12 is revised as follows:
"Where damage is caused by a traffic accident due to a product defect in a motor vehicle, if a party requests the producer or seller to bear compensation liability in accordance with the provisions of Chapter IV of Part VII of the Civil Code, the People's Court shall support such request."
7. Article 13 is revised as follows:
"Where multiple motor vehicles cause damage to a third party in a traffic accident, and a party requests multiple tortfeasors to bear compensation liability, the People's Court shall distinguish different circumstances and determine whether the tortfeasors shall bear joint and several liability or several liability in accordance with Articles 1170, 1171, and 1172 of the Civil Code."
8. Article 14 is revised as follows:
"The 'personal injury or death' as provided in Article 76 of the Road Traffic Safety Law refers to the damage caused by a motor vehicle traffic accident infringing upon the victim's rights to life, bodily integrity, health, and other personal rights and interests, including the various damages provided in Articles 1179 and 1183 of the Civil Code.
The 'property loss' as provided in Article 76 of the Road Traffic Safety Law refers to the loss caused by a motor vehicle traffic accident infringing upon the victim's property rights and interests."
9. Article 16 is revised as follows:
"Where a motor vehicle that is insured with both compulsory third party liability insurance for motor vehicles (hereinafter referred to as 'compulsory traffic accident liability insurance') and commercial third party liability insurance (hereinafter referred to as 'commercial third party insurance') causes damage in a traffic accident, and the party simultaneously sues the tortfeasor and the insurance company, the People's Court shall determine the compensation liability in accordance with Article 1213 of the Civil Code.
Where the victim or his or her close relative requests the insurer under the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance to give priority to compensation for moral damage, the People's Court shall support such request."
10. Article 19 is revised as follows:
"Where a motor vehicle that has not been insured with compulsory traffic accident liability insurance according to law causes damage in a traffic accident, if a party requests the person obliged to insure to make compensation within the liability limit of the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance, the People's Court shall support such request.
Where the person obliged to insure and the tortfeasor are not the same person, and a party requests that the person obliged to insure and the tortfeasor bear corresponding liability within the liability limit of the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance, the People's Court shall support such request."
11. The order of the articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

25. Revision of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Disputes over Food and Drug Products
1. The introductory part is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly adjudicating cases involving disputes over food and drug products, these Provisions are formulated in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests, the Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China, the Drug Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other laws, and in light of adjudication practice."
2. Article 6 is revised as follows:
"The producer and seller of food shall bear the burden of adducing evidence that the food meets quality standards. Whether food is safe shall be determined on the basis of national standards; for local specialty food, if there is no national standard, it shall be determined on the basis of local standards. If there are no such standards, it shall be determined on the basis of the relevant provisions of the Food Safety Law."
3. Article 8 is revised as follows:
"Where the operator of a centralized trading market, the lessor of a counter, or the organizer of a fair fails to perform the obligations of review, inspection, reporting, etc. as provided in the Food Safety Law, thereby causing damage to the lawful rights and interests of consumers, if a consumer requests such operator, lessor, or organizer to bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall support such request."
4. Article 9 is revised as follows:
"Where a consumer suffers damage from purchasing food or drugs through a third-party online trading platform, and the provider of the third-party online trading platform fails to provide the true name, address, and valid contact information of the producer or seller of the food or drugs, if the consumer requests the provider of the third-party online trading platform to bear liability, the People's Court shall support such request.
After the provider of the third-party online trading platform bears compensation liability, if it exercises the right of recourse against the producer or seller, the People's Court shall support such request.
Where the provider of the third-party online trading platform knows or ought to know that the producer or seller of food or drugs uses its platform to infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of consumers, but fails to take necessary measures, thereby causing damage to consumers, if a consumer requests that such provider bear joint and several liability together with the producer or seller, the People's Court shall support such request."
5. Article 10 is revised as follows:
"Where a civil subject that has not obtained the qualification for food production or sale, by being affiliated with a producer or seller having corresponding qualifications, produces or sells food and causes damage to a consumer, if the consumer requests the affiliated party and the party granting the affiliation to bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall support such request.
If the consumer only sues the affiliated party or the party granting the affiliation, the People's Court may, when necessary, add the relevant parties to participate in the proceedings."
6. Article 11 is revised as follows:
"Where a consumer suffers damage due to quality problems of food or drugs recommended by false advertisements, and requests the advertising operator or advertising publisher to bear joint and several liability in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests and other laws, the People's Court shall support such request.
Where another civil subject recommends food or drugs to consumers in false advertisements, thereby causing damage to consumers, and the consumer requests such subject to bear joint and several liability together with the producer or seller of the food or drugs in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests and other laws, the People's Court shall support such request."
7. Article 14 is revised as follows:
"Where there are quality problems in the food or drug produced or sold, and the producer and seller need to bear civil liability, administrative liability, and criminal liability simultaneously, but their property is insufficient to pay, if a party requests that the producer or seller of the food or drug bear civil liability first in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Civil Code and other laws, the People's Court shall support such request."
8. Article 15 is revised as follows:
"Where food that does not meet safety standards is produced, or food that is known to not meet safety standards is sold, in addition to claiming compensation for losses, if a consumer claims compensation from the producer or seller in accordance with the provisions of the Food Safety Law and other laws, the People's Court shall support such claim.
Where counterfeit drugs or substandard drugs are produced, or knowingly counterfeit or substandard drugs are still sold or used, in addition to claiming compensation for losses, if the victim or his or her close relative claims compensation from the producer or seller in accordance with the provisions of the Drug Administration Law and other laws, the People's Court shall support such claim."
9. Article 17 is revised as follows:
"Disputes between consumers and producers, sellers, advertising operators, advertising publishers, recommenders, inspection agencies, or other subjects of products such as cosmetics and health foods shall be handled by reference to these Provisions.
Where a government authority or relevant organization prescribed by law initiates a public interest litigation according to law, these Provisions shall apply by reference."
10. A new article is added as Article 18:
"For the purposes of these Provisions, 'producer of drugs' includes the drug marketing authorization holder and the drug manufacturing enterprise, and 'seller of drugs' includes the drug distribution enterprise and the medical institution."
11. The order of the articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

26. Revision of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Civil Disputes Arising from Infringement upon Personal Rights and Interests via Information Networks
1. The introductory part is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly adjudicating civil disputes arising from infringement upon personal rights and interests via information networks, these Provisions are formulated in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Strengthening the Protection of Network Information, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other laws, and in light of adjudication practice."
2. Articles 2, 5, 8, 12, 15, and 16 are deleted.
3. Article 3 is revised as follows:
"If a plaintiff sues a network user or a network service provider in accordance with Articles 1195 and 1197 of the Civil Code, the People's Court shall accept the case.
Where the plaintiff only sues the network user, and the network user requests to add the network service provider suspected of infringement as a joint defendant or a third party, the People's Court shall permit such request.
Where the plaintiff only sues the network service provider, and the network service provider requests to add a identifiable network user as a joint defendant or a third party, the People's Court shall permit such request."
4. Article 6 is revised as follows:
"When applying the provisions of Paragraph 2 of Article 1195 of the Civil Code to determine whether the necessary measures taken by the network service provider, such as deletion, blocking, or disconnection of links, are timely, the People's Court shall make a comprehensive judgment based on factors such as the type and nature of the network service, the form and accuracy of the effective notice, and the type and degree of the infringement of rights and interests by the network information."
5. Article 7 is revised as follows:
"Where a network user whose published information has been subjected to measures such as deletion, blocking, or disconnection of links claims that the network service provider shall bear liability for breach of contract or tort liability, and the network service provider defends on the ground that it has received an effective notice as specified in Paragraph 1 of Article 1195 of the Civil Code, the People's Court shall support such defense."
6. Article 9 is revised as follows:
"When determining whether a network service provider 'knows or ought to know' in accordance with Article 1197 of the Civil Code, the People's Court shall comprehensively consider the following factors:
(1) whether the network service provider has processed the infringing network information by means of recommendation, ranking, selection, editing, sorting, modification, etc., manually or automatically;
(2) the network service provider's ability to manage information, as well as the nature and manner of the services it provides, and the likelihood of infringement arising therefrom;
(3) the type and obviousness of the infringement upon personal rights and interests by the network information;
(4) the degree of social impact of the network information or the number of page views within a certain period;
(5) the technical possibility for the network service provider to take preventive measures against infringement and whether it has taken corresponding reasonable measures;
(6) whether the network service provider has taken corresponding reasonable measures against repeated infringements by the same network user or the same infringing information;
(7) other factors relevant to the case."
7. Article 17 is revised as follows:
"Where a network user or a network service provider infringes upon the personal rights and interests of another person, causing property loss or serious moral damage, if the infringed party requests them to bear compensation liability in accordance with Articles 1182 and 1183 of the Civil Code, the People's Court shall support such request."
8. Article 18 is revised as follows:
"The reasonable expenses paid by the infringed party to stop the infringing act may be recognized as the property loss specified in Article 1182 of the Civil Code. Reasonable expenses include the reasonable costs incurred by the infringed party or the authorized agent in investigating and collecting evidence of the infringing act. Upon the request of the party and based on the specific circumstances of the case, the People's Court may include the lawyer's fees that comply with the relevant provisions of the state in the scope of compensation.
Where the property loss caused to the infringed party due to the infringement of personal rights and interests and the benefits gained by the infringer therefrom are difficult to determine, the People's Court may determine the amount of compensation within the range of not more than RMB 500,000 based on the specific circumstances of the case."
9. The order of the articles shall be adjusted accordingly.

27. Revision of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Private Lending
1. The introductory part is revised as follows:
"For the purpose of correctly adjudicating cases involving disputes over private lending, these Provisions are formulated in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other laws, and in light of adjudication practice."
2. Article 10 is deleted.
3. Article 11 is revised as follows:
"For a private lending contract concluded between legal persons, between unincorporated organizations, or between them for the purpose of production or business operation, unless there exist circumstances as specified in Articles 146, 153, and 154 of the Civil Code and Article 13 of these Provisions, if a party claims that the private lending contract is valid, the People's Court shall support such claim."
4. Article 12 is revised as follows:
"Where a legal person or an unincorporated organization raises funds from its employees in the form of loans within the unit for the unit's production or business operation, and there exist no circumstances as specified in Articles 144, 146, 153, and 154 of the Civil Code and Article 13 of these Provisions, if a party claims that the private lending contract is valid, the People's Court shall support such claim."
5. Article 13 is revised as follows:
"Where the lending act of the borrower or the lender is suspected of constituting a crime, or has been determined to constitute a crime by an effective judgment, and a party initiates a civil action, the private lending contract shall not be automatically void. The People's Court shall determine the validity of the private lending contract in accordance with Articles 144, 146, 153, and 154 of the Civil Code and Article 13 of these Provisions.
Where a guarantor claims that it shall not bear civil liability on the ground that the lending act of the borrower or the lender is suspected of constituting a crime or has been determined to constitute a crime by an effective judgment, the People's Court shall determine the civil liability of the guarantor in accordance with the validity of the private lending contract and the guarantee contract and the degree of fault of the parties according to law."
6. Article 29 is revised as follows:
"If the lender and the borrower have agreed on an overdue interest rate, such agreement shall prevail, provided that it does not exceed four times the one-year loan prime rate at the time of conclusion of the contract.
If the overdue interest rate is not agreed upon or the agreement is unclear, the People's Court may handle the matter by distinguishing different circumstances:
(1) If neither the interest rate within the loan period nor the overdue interest rate is agreed upon, and the lender claims that the borrower shall bear the liability for breach of contract for overdue repayment by paying interest calculated by reference to the then-current one-year loan prime rate standard from the date of overdue repayment, the People's Court shall support such claim;
(2) If the interest rate within the loan period is agreed upon but the overdue interest rate is not agreed upon, and the lender claims that the borrower shall pay interest for the period of fund occupation at the interest rate within the loan period from the date of overdue repayment, the People's Court shall support such claim."
7. Article 32 is revised as follows:
"After these Provisions come into force, these Provisions shall apply to newly accepted first-instance cases involving disputes over private lending by the People's Court.
For a first-instance private lending case newly accepted after August 20, 2020, if the lending contract was concluded before August 20, 2020, and a party requests to apply the then-effective judicial interpretation to calculate the interest portion from the conclusion of the contract to August 19, 2020, the People's Court shall support such request; for the interest portion from August 20, 2020 to the date of repayment, it shall be calculated based on the interest rate protection standard of these Provisions at the time of filing the lawsuit.
After these Provisions come into force, if any relevant judicial interpretation previously issued by the Supreme People's Court is inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail."
8. The order of the articles shall be adjusted accordingly.
This Decision shall come into force as of January 1, 2021.
Pursuant to this Decision, the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Trade Union Law of the People's Republic of China in Civil Adjudication and twenty-six other civil-type judicial interpretations shall be revised accordingly and re-promulgated.
